ev_0005.summary: Seven labelled points (A, B, C, D, E, F, G) with bindings taken from the verified supervisor list. Line F-E-C is one straight line (E lies within about 1 px of it), and its stroke overhangs F by about 180 px to y~56; it is kept as the line object line_FC with the overhang as genuine extent. Base BC is horizontal at y=833, and AD is horizontal at y=408 (both verified CV spans with snapped endpoints), so AD is parallel to BC. Edge FB crosses AD at G (computed intersection (515.8,408) vs G=(516.0,408)), so G lies on both FB and AD. Edges AB, EB, FA are also present. The FB, AB, FA and EB spans overshoot their endpoints by about 8-18 px; these were snapped to the labelled vertices except for the FA and AB overhangs past A, which are flagged. No right-angle marker was verified, so none is submitted. The figure is the triangle FBC with E on side FC, cevian-like segments BE and FA/AB from B and A, and horizontal AD through G.
